༄༅/ /dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid

gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dam pa'i bde mchog bdud rtsis nges bran pa'i/ /shes rab mdzes ma'i tshogs kyis rtsen pa'i sku/ /dpyid kyi dga' bas sems can phan dges kyang*/ /bdud kyi stobs 'joms he ru ka la 'dud/ /mgon po de yis nges par yang*/ /byang chub la sbyar mkhas rnams kyis/ /rnam dag gzhung lam bstan pa la/ /byed pa ci yang dge legs nyid/ /'dir dpal sangs rgyas thod pa las 'byung ba/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams byas la/ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor srung ba byas shing*/ 'og nas 'chad pa ltar nang mchod byin gyis rlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsi myangs par 'dir 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma sbyin par mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel las 'byung ba ltar byas kyang legs/ ma 'grub kyang 'gal ba med do/ / rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyis dpal he ru ka gnyug ma'i dga' ma sna tshogs bde mas 'khyud pa/ phreng bzang ma la sogs pa rdo rje rol pa mo nyi shu rtsa bzhis bskor ba spyan drangs te/ rang la mngon du phyogs pas bzhugs par gyur/ 'od zer rnams snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ las lha mo brgyad cig car sprul nas mchod par gyur/ 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma/ /brgyad po bu mo rnams kyi mchog /mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa yis/ /mgon po he ru ka mchod do/ /rdo rje mgon po'i shar gnas pa/ rdo rje mche ba ma yis ni/ /thod pa khrag gis bkang bzung ste/ /gzi brjid chen po gsol bar mdzod/ /rdo rje pho nya bdag nyid che/ dbang ldan du ni cang te'u brdung*/ /rdo rje gdod ma dri snod dang*/ /me yi phyogs su rnam par gnas/ /rdo rje can ma grags chen mo/ /mchod yon snod can bden bral ni/

/rdo rje gtsigs ma lho yi ni/ /phyag na rnga bo che 'dzin gsungs/ /rlung du rdo rje lte ba ma/ /ri bong can gyi snod 'dzin no/ /nub tu rdo rje 'jigs ma ni/ /lce spyang phyag na 'dzin par gsungs/ /byang du 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lha mo'i chags pas gtso bo mchod/ / de ltar he ru ka bsam nas/ /rnal 'byor ma ni brgyad kyis mchod/ /sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs skom/ /sna tshogs rol mo mchog gsungs dang*/ /dri zhim lnga dang me tog spos/ /'di dag gis ni gtso bo mchod/ /mchod yon zhal bsil de bzhin khrus/ /glu yi mchog ni rnam mang pos/ /mgon po khrag 'thung bdag nyid che/ /'di dag gis ni mchod par bya/ / zhes pa ni mchod pa'o/ /rgyas pa la spro na/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod sngags rnams kyis mchod do/ khrag 'thung yon tan zab mnga' ba/ / dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /sems can kun la phan dgyes dang*/ /sna tshogs sde la rtag tu 'dud/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po che/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dra ba sdom/ /dngos kun rang bzhin 'gro ba skyob/ /sna tshogs sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes phyag bya/ bdag gis bdag nyid kyi sdig pa thams cad 'chags shing slar yang mi bgyid do/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ so so'i skye bo thams cad kyi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bdag nyid kyi dge ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa chos dkon mchog dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog la byang chub kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o/ /kye ma ma la bdag gis sems can kun gyi don dang*/ phan pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ ji srid du de rnams shin tu mthar thug pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la bkod pa'i bar du de'i lam sgrub pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par byang chub par bgyi'o/

/ zhes lan gsum mo/ / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /'og gi rlung gis bskul bas 'bar ba'i gtum mo'i mes 'khyud pa'i snying ga'i hūṃ las/ 'od zer 'phros khams gsum ma lus pa bsregs te stong par sbyangs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa utpa ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu las/ raṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla re mda'i dra ba/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar po'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan dang yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba bdun dang raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rje dang laṃ gyi mtshan pa/ de ltar 'byung ba bzhi ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ sngo dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang*/ dra ba dang*/ dra ba phyed pa dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mnga' yab dang ldan pa/ rtsigs pa'i phyi rol du mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang ldan pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor ba/ rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin las byung ba ka ba dang*/ dril bu la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus phyur bu'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/

nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ser nub dmar lho nag /dbus sngo ba'i sa gzhi'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ rtsibs chan sngon po/ mu khyud la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ rtsibs chan ljang khu mu khyud la rdo rje dmar po'i rwa bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la rdo rje sngon pos rwa bas bskor ba/ 'khor lo'i lte ba sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pas khyab pa/ de'i lte ba sngon po la slar yang padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin mi ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo phyi ma gnyis kyi rtsibs rnams su pad nyi dang*/ sgo bzhir padma nyi ma mi ro'i gdan rnams so/ /me lce'i khor yug gi phyi rol du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba ni/ shing brgyad kyi rtse mor zhing skyong brgyad dang*/ rtsa ba na phyogs skyong ba rnams dang*/ klu'i dbang po brgyad dang*/ sprin gyi bdag po brgyad dang*/ mngon par 'phags pa'i ri brgyad dang*/ de la gnas pa'i mchod rten brgyad dang*/ drag tu 'bab pa'i chu klung brgyad dang*/ rab tu 'bar ba'i me brgyad dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs dang*/ sbrul gyis khyab pa/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ shing la dpyangs pa dang*/ phyed tshig pa dang*/ dum bur gyur pa dang*/ ma gyur pa'i mi ro sna tshogs dang*/ rus pa'i dum bus khyab pa/ ro langs dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ grub pa thob pa dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yongs su rgyu bas ngo mtshar bar byed pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes so/

/de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzñā nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod pa ni/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /zla nyi rdo rje hūṃ yig dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sku yongs su rdzogs par grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das yab yum grub pa na/ nor bu dang nor bu'i 'od zer gyi tshul gyis/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang*/ hūṃ yig de nyid kyi snang ba las grub ste/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ kun da dang zla 'od ltar dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i sku las nor bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na cang te dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis na kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa ltar mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs bde ma dmar mos 'khyud pa'o/ / spyir rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sngon pos kyang rung la/ bram ze chen pos mdzad par grags pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ skabs 'dir g.yas gnyis gri thod g.yon gnyis kha ṭwāṃ rdo rje/ yum yang dkar mo phyag gnyis mas phyag mtshan bzhi bzung ba ste/ g.yas cang te'i steng na gri gug dang*/ g.yon kha ṭwāṃ thod pa lhan cig par bshad pa'ang snang ngo*/ / thugs kyi 'khor lo'i 'dab ma rnams la/ shar du 'phreng bzang ma/ byang du thod can ma/ nub tu 'jigs byed ma/ lhor thub dka' ma/ dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/

g.yas bskor gyi khu ba dang*/ rdul dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ sgron ma lngas gang ba'i thod pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la/ shar du dge ba'i ska rags can ma/ byang du gzugs can ma/ nub tu rnam rgyal ma/ lhor 'byung gnas ma/ dbang ldan du dus can ma/ mer mtsho chen ma/ bden bral du byed can ma/ rlung du sdud byed ma'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la/ shar du sgrol byed ma/ byang du 'jigs mthong ma/ nub tu legs mthong ma/ lhor mi pham ma/ dbang ldan du dge ba ma/ mer grib gnon ma/ bden bral du dus mtshan ma/ rlung du grags chen ma/ shar sgor mdzes sdug ma/ byang sgor nor 'dzin ma/ nub sgor skal bzang ma/ lhor sgor yid 'ong ma/ 'di dag kyang mtshan nyid dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs dang 'dra'o/ / lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsis bcom ldan 'das la yang dag par mchod cing*/ yum gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hū ཾ / gsang bar swā/ brla gnyis la hā/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis sku gang*/ yum gyi bha ga hrīḥlas byung ba'i padma dmar po/ lte ba la āḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi liṅga hū ཾ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse mo la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sna tshogs bde ma dang lhan cig dbyer med pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'dod pa mdzad de bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ngo*/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ rjes su chags pa'i mes shes rab ma'i 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig zhu bar gyur pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la khu ba'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur to/ / dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas thig le las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ gdung ba dang bcas pas bskul ba ni/ / byams pa'i rang bzhin 'phreng bzang mas/ /ci ste 'jig rten snyan mnan na/ /ci ste khyod ni mi dgyes gyur/

/gal te khyod bdag tshig gsan na/ / mi dgyes gyur ba mtha' dag thong*/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin thod can mas/ /stong pa'i gzugs ni ma mdzad par/ /nyid kyi dgongs pa grags par mdzod/ /srid 'jigs skye bo kun bslu bas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi grogs po bzhengs/ /dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'jigs byed mas/ /bdag po sngon gsungs dran par mdzod/ / bya bar sgyid lug ma mdzad cig khyod mi snang na skye bo kun/ /lhung bas 'gro ba mi dgar 'gyur/ /btang snyoms rang bzhin thub dka' mas/ /log pa'i nga rgyal ma mdzad par/ /mdza' bo stong pa'i rang bzhin thong*/ /dngos po mtha' yas khyod thong la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la spyod/ / tshigs bcad 'di dag mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel 'gyur gsar na drangs pa rnams go bde zhing 'gyur legs par snang yang*/ lag len mdzad pa'i rgyun la gyi jo'i 'gyur bzhin mdzad kyin snang bas de ltar drangs so/ /sa ra has mdzad zer ba'i sgrub thabs ltar na/ gtso bo yab yum zhu ba ma gtogs 'khor gyi lha mo rnams gnas shing de'i phyir thig le las lha mo spro ba med la/ bskul mkhan yang mdzes sdug ma la sogs pa sgo ma bzhis byed do/ / de ltar bskul ma thag tu thig le de nyid hūṃ du gyur zhing*/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po chu shing gi me tog gsar du kha bye ba lta bu'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos cang te'u steng du 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon gyi dang pos kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po gyen du bsgreng ba/ g.yas 'og mas gri gug bsnun pa'i tshul can/ g.yon 'og mas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ sna tshogs padma'i lte bar padma dmar po dang mi ro'i snying ga la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ 'jigs shing khros la drag po'i sku can/

nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsar du shar ba lta bu'i spyan gsum pa/ zhal nas hūṃ gi sgra sgrog pas bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad sdigs shing phye mar mdzad pa/ mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ thal ba chen pos sku la nye bar brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs rgyab kyi char 'dzin pa/ mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa'i tshangs skud dang*/ dpral bar thod pa lnga'i phreng bas brgyan zhing*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdub bu dang*/ ske rags te rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ thugs rje chen pos lus can rnams 'khor ba las 'don par mdzad pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs bde ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang mo ni/ sku mdog bandhu ltar dmar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan can/ rnam par 'gyur pa'i zhal/ dbu skra kham ser grol zhing gyen du 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yon pas thod pa rang byung sihla'i rgyun gyis gang ba 'dzin zha

ི nga yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa steng du sgreng bas/ gdug pa thams cad la bsnun par mdzad pa/ sgeg cing g.yo bas rtsen pa'i sku/ shid kyi sgra dang bcas pa'i sgyu rtsal dang rtsed 'jos rol pa can no/ / mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel las yab he ru ka dbu skra nag po ral pa'i cod pan du byas par bshad de gdam nga yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /gtso bo yab yum grub pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang skad cig gis grub par gyur te/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i 'dab ma rnams la/ zhes pa nas/ lho sgor yid 'ong ma ste rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyang sngon mo ind+ra nī las 'od zer 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'dzum khros mche ba gtsigs shing skra ser gyen du grol ba/ me tog mandha ra ba kha bye ba lta bu'i nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ sgo skyong ma bzhi ni dbugs bral gyi gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs dang gzhan rnams g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa lnga po thams cad mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang phreng ba spangs shing rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ phyogs kyi gos can/ zhal nas khrag chen gyi zegs ma 'thor ba/ rab tu chags pas zla ba'i rgyun 'bab pa'o/ / yang na gdam nga la thugs 'khor ba rnams nag mo gsung 'khor ba rnams dkar ser/ sku 'khor ba rnams ljang khu/ sgo skyong rnams nag mor yang bsdus pa'i rgyud nyid las bshad pa ltar bya la/ /yang thugs 'khor ba dang sgo skyong rnams phyogs mdog /gsung 'khor pa rnams dmar mo/ sku 'khor pa rnams dang*/ sna tshogs bde ma yang dkar mor sa ra ha'i gzhung du grags pa las 'byung zhing*/ de nyid rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin par yang grags la/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ 'jigs byed ma dkar mor 'dod pa yang bshad pa dang*/

rdzogs 'phreng las gtso bo he ru ka'i smad g.yogs glang po che'i pags pa yang bshad la/ 'khor nyer bzhi stag lpags rgyab tu 'phyar ba byed pa'ang yod pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ yum sna tshogs bde ma phyag bzhi phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra ba yang da lta'i rgyud 'di las gsungs te/ de dag las rang nyid ji ltar mos pa zhig bsgom par bya'o/ / bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar oṃ/ dpral bar haṃ/ mgrin par heṃ/ spyi bor haiṃ/ phrag pa gnyis la hoṃ/ mig gnyis la hauauṃ/ gsang ba la ha ི / lus thams cad la haḥ zhes pa go cha'o/ / thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje nag po'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par aḥlas padma dmar po as mtshan pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ de las 'od 'phros/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ zhes bgegs bskrad/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka rā ra thaṃ/ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sgo ma bzhi pos dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ oṃ buddha ka pā li nī āḥkhaṃ braṃ druṃ sruṃ āṃ āṃ āṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes ye shes sems dpa' dang ro mnyam gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ de nas/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar bas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor gnas pa'i bdud rtsi zhu zhing babs te/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i sa bon la khrus gsol ba'i dus su/ de'i rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro ma brgyad/ sgeg cing mdzes sdug phun sum tshogs pa/ lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can rnams kyis/ byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ 'dzum pa'i 'od zer dang bcas pa phyir spros/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas spyan drangs pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rig pa'i lha mor bcas pa rnams/ rab tu dwangs shing bzhad pa'i 'dzum dmul te/

he ru ka rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig ces gsung bzhin gyur/ yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol 'debs na/ thugs rje che dang ldan pa rnams/ / bdag la dbang ni skur du gsol/ /brtse ldan grags pa chen po pas/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbang bskur/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag / dbang bskur pa yis bdag sgrol mdzod/ /oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa ntu māṃ/ sarba yo gī ṇyo mu ku ṭe a tra a dhi tiṣṭhantu ā gatstshantu hūṃ swāhā/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshon dang ba dan dang*/ gos dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba thams cad dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar po 'dzin pa rnams kyis khrus gsol ba dang*/ bkra shis dang*/ rnga bo che'i sgra dang*/ tsandan dang gur gum dang me tog la sogs pa'i char phab cing*/ phyi dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /de nas dbang lha rnams snying ga'i rtsa brgyad la thim/ gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo la/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa dang*/ sna tshogs bde ma la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ thugs 'khor ba rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ gsung 'khor ba rnams la 'od dpag med dang*/ sku 'khor ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ sgo skyong rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan rtsa brgyad po las byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad po rnams kyi gtso bo la mchod par gyur/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ma ṭa ma ṭa a swāhā/ me tog 'bul ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ mahā ka pā la badzrī ba ra ba ra ta ṭa sta ṭa ya sta ṭa ya ma ṭa ma ṭa hūṃ he swāhā/ dri chab 'bul ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ta ṭa spho ṭa ya sarba shu bha pra dā yi ni hūṃ phaṭa/ sbos 'bul ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ buddha ka pā li ni gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya ba ra ba ra ta ṭa ta ṭa/

sta ṭa ya sta ra ya ma ṭa hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ mar me 'bul pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ buddha ka pā li ni/ gṛhṇa gṛhna gṛhna pa ya gṛhna pa ya khā khā hūṃ/ lha bshos 'bul ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ mahā ka pā li badzra dharma dharma me ghe ba re pra ba re ba ra ba ra ka ra ka ra/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ ha he swāhā/ gos 'bul ba'i sngags so/ /skabs 'dir/ spro na gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ tshigs bcad brjod pas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa mtha' dag 'bul ba skabs su bab pa'ang yin no/ /de nas/ rdo rje dang ni padma 'dus shing bdud rtsis bde rgyas shing*/ / rim gyis yongs gyur sku can sems can don du gar byed pa/ /rdo rje lha mo'i rtsed mo'i rol bas rtser mdzod 'gro rmongs la/ /'gro la mi dman kun dga' ster ba khyod la bdag 'dud do/ / zhes bstod/ de nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnams spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa/ ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la/ lha thams cad kyi ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas/ gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ nang gi bdud rtsi myang ba'o/ /nang mchod bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po zur gsum pa 'bar ba bdun gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'o/ /de'i nang du bam̐ ram̐ shūm̐ mam̐ mum̐ rnams las dri chen rakta byang sems kyi klad pa dri chu ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ gam̐ kum̐ dam̐ ham̐ nam̐ rnams las ba glang khyi glang po rta mi sha ste sgron ma lnga la/

oṃ hūṃ khaṃ swā hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba'i rlangs pa rnams steng gi bar snang la hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa la reg pas de zhu nas thod par lhung ba rdzas rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ yang mtho gang tsam gyi bar snang la/ oṃ las zla ba oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa dang*/ nor bu dang sngags dang sman gyi nus pa'i bye brag thams cad bkug ste rdzas la thim pas/ de thams cad dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ yang lan gcig gis bdud rtsi myangs nas/ hūṃ dkar po las skyes pa'i ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pas drangs te gsol bar bsam ste/ phyi'i bdud rtsi myangs ba'o/ / de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa thams cad rmi lam lta bur bsam zhing*/ sprul pa spro bsdus sems can gyi don byed pa ni las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ / de nas mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel ltar na/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag dang mtshungs par/ lus dkyil sgom par yang mdzad de/ de ltar spyir shin tu 'thad cing*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin te/ sgom par spro na gzhung 'grel nyid las tshol bar bya'o/ /'on kyang bsdus rgyud 'di'i dngos bstan la med pas na/ med mi rung gi yan lag tu mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'i don du brtsams pa'i skabs 'dir ma bris so/ /de nas yang 'di ltar sgom te/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo padma 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i kha steng du phyogs pa'i/ mdud pa'i bu gar aṃ sngon po'o/

/chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa 'og tu kha phyogs pa'i bu gar hūṃ sngon po'o/ /steng du kha phyogs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i bu gar oṃ dmar po'o/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'og tu kha phyogs pa'i bu gar haṃ dkar po'o/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lor gnas pa'i rlung gis bskul ba'i me gtum mo'i rang bzhin aṃ yig 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis bzhu ba'i hūṃ yig la sogs pa yi ge gsum dang lhan cig dbyer med pa'i aṃ yig lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur pa'i dpa' bo sgom zhing*/ sgom pa yongs su smin par mos = nas/ de nyid las 'od zer gyi re kha phra mo me lce 'bar ba ltar gnas pas blta bar bya'o/ /de mthus bdud rtsi 'dzags pas gang ste dpa' bo bkrus pa na 'od zer gyi re kha de yang bsil bar gyur te/ de nas dpa' bo la sems nges pas/ ji srid du sems brtan pa thob par mtshan ma rnams kyi nye bar dmigs pa de srid du blta bar bya'o/ /brtan pa nye bar mtshon pa na/ 'od zer gyi re kha de'i snang bas sna tshogs pa gsal bar snang bar byed par bsam ste/ thams cad lag mthil gyi skyu ru ra ltar blta'o/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyang myur du rdzogs par bya'o/ / zhes pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ / de nas bzlas pa ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ ngag bzlas bya ste/ oṃ hrīḥbuddha hūṃ ka pā li ni āḥ zhes pa ste rtsa ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ buddha ka pā li nī āḥhrīḥhai hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ / oṃ buddha ka pā li nī badzri ṇī hau dur dza ya dur lakṣe hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni nye ba'i snying po'o/ /de ltar ci 'grub tu bzlas la/ gtor bsngo mi byed na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu bya'o/ /'grub na bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma nges par bya ste/

gtor ma nang me chod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ skad cig tsam gyis ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par byon pa/ bdag nyid kyis sgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ gong gi dam ye bsre ba'i sngags lan gsum bzlas/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la phyogs skyong ba thams cad kyang gnas par gyur/ gong bzhin chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lnga dang lha mo brgyad kyi sa mchod/ oṃ buddha ka pā li ni ba liṃ gṛhṇā gṛhṇā/ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya khā khā hūṃ/ zhas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la lan bdun gyis phul/ oṃ buddha ka pā la badzra tsa ṭe su tse ṭe/ a £¨ laṃ ba ne + khaṃ bā re £© prī ṇā ya/ sarb+ba bhū tā na/ ma rā ya sarb+ba mā rā na/ kī la ya sarb+ba duṣtā na/ u tsa ṭa ya sarb+ba bighnān/ bi dra bā ya/ bho bha ga wa te/ yakṣa rakṣa sa/ pī shā tsa na/ sho ṣa ya/ tā ḍa ya/ sasta pā tā la ga tā na/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs la phul/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rtog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don gyi mnyam med byos/ /'on te sangs rgyas sras bu skyes/ / zhes chos bshad nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / sems can thams cad skyon med pa'i/ /lam de nyid du zhugs nas kyang*/ / sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad gyur cig /ma grol ba rnams grol bar shog /ma brgal ba rnams brgal bar shog /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam pa la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog / ces dge ba bsngos nas/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang = zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi /

bar gyis phrin las bcol/ arghaṃ= nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod pa spyi dang 'dra bar phul/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams byas te/ khu tshur sa la brkyang nas se gol gtogs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes pa dang dril bu 'khrol bas gshegs su gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa/ bdag gis sgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dur khrod brgyad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo= de gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa la= de yang lha rnams la= lha rnams gtso bo yab yum la= gtso bo yab yum yang thugs ka'i hūṃ la= de yang 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ bar skabs der/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de las thun mtshams kyi lha sku bsgoms te dge ba bsngo'o/ /gal te dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i rjes su gtor ma bsngo na/ mdun bskyed dam tshig pa sa bon ni sngags tsam las bskyed/ ye shes pa dang bsres nas gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na skad cig gis bskyed nas spyan drangs kyang chog ste/ gshegs gsol gyi mthar yang smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'grub bya'o/ /gzhan rnal 'byor gyi yan lag rnams ni/ theg pa bla na med pa'i bskyed rim gyi sgrub thabs spyi dang 'dra bas 'dir ma brjod do/ /

dam pa rnams ni chos kyi bang mdzod 'dzin/ /gsar pa'i legs bshad rgyas kyang ngoms pa med/ /skye bo nyon mongs can gyi thibs por yang*/ /theg mchog nyi 'od 'jug pa 'ga' la srid/ /de phyir mchog tu rnyed dka' ba'i/ / sgrub thabs byas pa'i dge ba gang*/ /kun la phan pa'i sems kyis te/ /mkha' khyab he ru kar gyur cig/ // ces pa dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po nyid slob dpon sa ra ha pas mdzad par byed pa'i gzhung 'grel bzhi dang bcas pa dang*/ padma badzra gyi mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel 'gyur 'phro dang*/ a bha yā ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i 'grel chen mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams la nges pa cung zad rnyed cing*/ de rnams las phal cher phyi ma nyid mchog tu mthong ste/ gtso bor de'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas jo nang dpal gyi ri khrod du sbya ra ba'o/ /bkra shis// //mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 212 -- PAGE 211 -- PAGE 208 -
